# The lighthouse islet: a jittered, flattened icosphere 3.2 x 2.6 m, its flat top at ~0.5 m,
# rock (876672) with grass (8da24e) on the faces that look up. In place, front-left of the harbour.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Islet --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location -3.0 -2.2 0
scale 1.6 1.3 0.75
apply
active Islet
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 4
select vert where "pos.z > 0.38"
scale z 0
mode object
material new Rock --base-color 0.529 0.400 0.447
material new Grass --base-color 0.553 0.635 0.306 --no-slot
active Islet
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.85"
material assign Grass
mode object
shade flat
inspect stats
export islet.glb
